investigation_trail.summary: planner handoff to PLANNING: charge_card retry-looping; pause_dag stops further promotion
plan: pause_dag({"root_job_id": "25220882-1820-5cd3-b09b-f866ff5823c9", "ttl_seconds": 600}) then verify via get_dag_state

verified: The verify probe shows paused=true with paused_expires_in_seconds=540 — the enforced pause is active and observable. Children remain in waiting as expected (pause halts promotion without flipping node statuses), and no new promotions appear.

findings: Saga at seed_id 25220882... had charge_card retrying (count=5) with ship_order waiting downstream. Paused the DAG with a 10-minute TTL to stop further child promotion. TTL self-cleans; no operator action needed to unpause if the underlying issue resolves itself.
recommendation: Investigate the payment gateway (charge_card's dependency) — the retry pattern is external, not code. If the gateway recovers within 10 minutes, the pause expires and the saga resumes. If not, extend the pause and start compensation (reserve_inventory rollback).
